source_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation trophy list, matched exactly to the bounty kit. Guides are original, written for this entry from those official descriptions; where a description is cryptic or a trigger is not yet confirmed in-game it is flagged provisional and the guide points at the community sources that track it.

stages.note: The opening story. The first two chapters and the early story jobs — all unmissable.
stages.title: Opening: Chapters 1–2

stages.note: Chapter 3 and its heists — all unmissable.
stages.title: Mid-story: Chapter 3

stages.note: Chapter 4, the takedown, and the final mission — all unmissable.
stages.title: Late story: Chapter 4 & finale

stages.note: The side strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, the Stranger and Freaks strands, and the two partner jobs with Lucia — do the partner jobs the first time they are offered.
stages.title: Partners & strangers

stages.note: The activity grind: stunts, shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, challenges, and the melee drive-bys.
stages.title: Activities & challenges

stages.note: The map sweep: meditation spots, cards, WAiNK, vehicles, areas, garages, and Scooter Bros registrations.
stages.title: Collectibles & exploration

stages.note: The combat and money work: gang operations, heists, vaults, trucks, and laundering and spending.
stages.title: Combat & economy

stages.note: The odd ones, the secret thread, the two provisional-missable choices, 100%, and the platinum.
stages.title: Odd, secret & platinum

trophies.guide: The platinum. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically — there is nothing extra to do. Use the checklist to track the 54, and the roadmap to order them so the four provisional missables are handled inside their story windows.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies
The platinum unlocks automatically
Check the roadmap for the missable order

trophies.guide: A story trophy from the opening. Play the first chapter's story missions until the Gone Fishing trip with the crew; the trophy pops when the scene ends. It cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening story missions
Reach the Gone Fishing trip scene
Finish the scene — the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play Chapter 1 missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Unmissable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2 missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3 missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4 missions in order
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Play through the story to the end; the trophy pops when the last mission's closing scene finishes. Unmissable, but it is the last story trophy — everything else can still be done after the credits in free roam.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the story to the end
Complete the final mission
The trophy pops at the closing scene

trophies.guide: A story mission early in the game. Play the story until the Breakfast Run job appears and complete it. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run job in the story
Complete it — the trophy pops on completion

trophies.guide: Complete the Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3. Follow the story to the heist setup, then run the heist to the end. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the Cartel Heist in the story
Complete the heist setup
Run the heist to the end

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. It is a story mission in the middle of the game; play the story until it appears and finish it. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story
Complete it — the trophy pops on completion

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. It is a story mission; play until it appears and finish it. Unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story
Complete it — the trophy pops on completion

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission late in the story. Play the story until the takedown appears and finish it. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in the story
Complete it — the trophy pops on completion

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late-story mission. Play the story until it appears and finish it. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story
Complete it — the trophy pops on completion

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long tail: finish the story, all activities, all collectibles, all challenges, and the side strands. The completion percentage is shown in the stats menu — check it there to find what is left. It is the last trophy most players earn before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story
Complete all activities, collectibles and challenges
Check the stats menu for the remaining percentage
The trophy pops at 100%

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, airtime, near-misses and trick moves the game tracks as you drive and ride. They add up naturally across the whole playthrough — drive fast, take jumps, and land cleanly. The stunt count is shown in the stats menu. If you are short at the end, replay jump spots and stunt ramps in free roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive and ride — stunts track automatically
Take jumps and land cleanly for airtime
Check the stunt count in the stats menu
Mop up the remainder at jump spots in free roam

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Leonida's activities include the shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, and more. Open the activities menu (or the map's activity filter) to see the full list, then try one of each type. You do not need to win or complete them — trying each type once is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list from the map or menu
Try one of each activity type
The trophy pops when every type has been tried

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range (marked on the map) and work through its challenge list — each range offers timed accuracy and speed drills, and the list is shown in-game at the range. You need a gold medal in every challenge, not just a pass, so replay the drills until the gold threshold is hit. This is the hardest activity trophy: steady aim, a few retries per drill, and the golds add up.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a shooting range on the map
Open its challenge list
Earn a gold medal in each challenge
Retry the timed drills until they pass gold

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Drone-race spots are marked on the map once the activity is unlocked; win a race at each one. The race list is shown in the activity menu. Fly clean lines and use the boost pads — the courses are short, so a retry is cheap.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Unlock the drone-race activity
Find the race spots on the map
Win a race at each location
The trophy pops when every location is won

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter races from the race markers on the map (street, off-road and water races all count). Each win must be a different race — repeating the same race does not count twice. If a race is hard, retry it with a better-tuned vehicle or a different route.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Find race markers on the map
Win a race
Win 19 more different races
The trophy pops on the twentieth different win

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival — his challenge appears as a fishing activity once you have fished a few times. Accept his challenge and out-fish him (heavier catch or more fish, as the challenge scores it). The fishing menu shows the challenge and your best catch.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Fish a few times to unlock Cal's challenge
Accept his fishing challenge
Beat Cal's score
The trophy pops on the win

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade (marked on the map), pick any game, and play it through to the end. You do not need to win — completing a game is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade on the map
Play any arcade game
Complete it — the trophy pops

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's missions appear as a side strand on the map — follow the strand's missions to the end. The strand is marked once it unlocks in the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Unlock Andy's strand in the story
Follow its missions on the map
Complete the final mission in the strand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's missions appear as a side strand on the map — follow the strand's missions to the end. The strand is marked once it unlocks in the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Unlock Kenton's strand in the story
Follow its missions on the map
Complete the final mission in the strand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's missions appear as a side strand on the map — follow the strand's missions to the end. The strand is marked once it unlocks in the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Unlock Billy's strand in the story
Follow its missions on the map
Complete the final mission in the strand

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. These are the odd side encounters marked on the map — each one is a short strand of missions. Work through all eight; the strand list is shown in the side-missions menu. None of them is tied to the story, so they can all be done in free roam after the credits.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Find the Stranger and Freaks markers on the map
Complete each strand
Check the side-missions menu for the remaining strands
The trophy pops on the eighth

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's missions appear as a side strand on the map — follow the strand's missions to the end. The strand is marked once it unlocks in the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Unlock Randy's strand in the story
Follow its missions on the map
Complete the final mission in the strand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's missions appear as a side strand on the map — follow the strand's missions to the end. The strand is marked once it unlocks in the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Unlock Tyrone's strand in the story
Follow its missions on the map
Complete the final mission in the strand

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet viewpoints scattered across the state — the map shows the ones you have found, and the collection menu counts them. Visit each spot and meditate. Community guides list all 18 locations; the in-game count tells you how many are left.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Open the collection menu to see the meditation count
Visit a meditation spot and meditate
Repeat for all 18 spots
Use a community guide for the last few

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a side strand — follow its missions on the map. The hunt asks you to track and take a unique animal; the strand marks the hunting ground once it is available. Follow the trail and complete the hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Unlock the Bret hunt strand
Follow its missions
Hunt the unique animal
Complete the hunt

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. The cards are hidden across the map in three sets — the collection menu shows which sets and cards you have. Pick them up as you explore; a community guide lists every card location for the final sweep.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Open the collection menu to see the card sets
Collect cards as you explore
Use a community guide for the last cards
The trophy pops when the third set is complete

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are the photo and location markers across Leonida — the collection menu counts them. Visit each one (the map shows the ones you have found). A community guide lists all 100 for the final sweep.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the collection menu to see the WAiNK count
Visit WAiNK locations as you travel
Use a community guide for the last few
The trophy pops at 100

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the tracked goals in the challenges menu — activities, combat, exploration and driving challenges all count. Open the menu to see the list, then work through 50 of them. They accumulate across the whole playthrough, so most players are well on the way by the end of the story.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges menu
Complete challenges across activities, combat and exploration
The trophy pops on the fiftieth

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner (Lucia) beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. Do it in an open area with a fast vehicle nearby — once the wanted level is lost, drive clear of the search zone until the heat is gone. Provisional missable: partner activities may only be available in story windows, so do this the first time a partner session is offered.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Start a session with your partner
Build a 4-star Wanted Level
Lose the police
Escape the search zone — the trophy pops

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob one shop, then immediately rob a second and a third — do not lose the wanted level between them. Plan a route with three close shops and a fast getaway vehicle. Provisional missable: partner activities may only be available in story windows.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Start a session with your partner
Rob a shop
Rob a second shop immediately
Rob a third without losing the Wanted Level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles are added to the collection when you drive them — the vehicle menu shows which ones you have found. Drive a wide variety (cars, bikes, boats, aircraft) and the count climbs. The menu shows what is left.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive different vehicles — each new one counts
Check the vehicle menu for the count
Try cars, bikes, boats and aircraft
The trophy pops at 100

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-mo aiming mode — activate it during a firefight with at least five enemies nearby, and take down five of them before the focus ends. Pick a crowded encounter (a gang operation or a police chase) and line the shots up while time is slowed. If the focus runs out, retry the encounter.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find an encounter with 5 or more enemies
Activate Combat Focus
Take down 5 enemies in that single use
The trophy pops on the fifth

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave by an unscheduled route — take an aircraft (or a vehicle) out of the airport without going through the normal departure. The exact trigger is the airport escape; community guides name the spot and the vehicle once the game is out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport)
Find the unscheduled departure route
Leave the airport by it — the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Disrupt the Rhinos gang. The description is a joke, but the trigger is the Rhinos gang — attack their operations (ambushes, stash raids, turf hits) as marked on the map until the chain is complete. The gang-activity menu shows your progress. Community guides confirm the exact count once the game is out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find Rhinos operations on the map
Disrupt them — ambushes, stash raids, turf hits
Complete the chain
Check the gang-activity menu for progress

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth heist — plan the approach, avoid the cameras and guards, and take the goods without raising the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails; retry it quietly. The heist is a story and side job — follow its setup missions first.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Reach the jewelry store heist job
Complete its setup missions
Rob the store without being detected

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are robbed as part of heist jobs — the job list shows which banks are available. Rob five vaults and escape after each one; each is a short heist sequence.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find bank-vault heist jobs
Rob a vault and escape
Repeat for 5 vaults

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks drive the roads of Leonida — intercept one (ram it, block it, or follow it to a stop), take the cash, and escape. The robbery activity marks truck routes once unlocked.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Intercept and stop it
Take the cash and escape — the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Areas are counted as you travel through them — the map shows which areas you have visited. Drive, fly and sail across the whole map; the area count is shown in the stats menu. A community guide lists all 52 areas for the final sweep.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel across Leonida — each new area counts
Check the area count in the stats menu
Use a community guide for the last areas
The trophy pops at 52

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each of the nine gangs runs illegal operations — the gang-activity menu lists them. Rob one operation per gang until all nine are done.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Open the gang-activity menu
Rob one Illegal Operation per gang
The trophy pops on the ninth gang

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, sit somewhere with a view, and order a cocktail from the menu. It is a small flavour moment — any bar on the beach works.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Enter a bar with a view
Order a cocktail from the menu

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. During the showroom sequence, drive out through the showroom itself — smash through the glass and the displays on your way out. The activity marker appears on the map once it unlocks.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find the showroom activity marker
Drive in and smash your way out
The trophy pops on the escape

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley (marked on the map), play a full game and follow through to the end. A completed game at this alley pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a full game
Follow through to the end — the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Set a personal best with a partner. The name says personal best and the description points at a partnership — the trigger is a best performance in a partnered activity (a race, a challenge, or a co-op moment with Lucia). The description is cryptic, so the exact activity is per community guides; the activity menu shows your bests, and beating one with your partner beside you is the way to test it.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Pick an activity you have played with your partner
Beat your own best score or time
Check community guides for the exact trigger

trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. Choices are the dialogue and activity decisions you make across the whole game — story conversations, side-strand options, and activity choices all count, and the total is tracked (500 in the kit data). They accumulate naturally, but the count is large, so pick the alternative option whenever one is offered. Provisional missable: some choices may only appear in story windows, so choose deliberately rather than skipping dialogue.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices in story dialogue and side strands
Pick the alternative option when offered
The count is shown in the stats menu
The trophy pops at 500

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one is triggered by a specific story moment — a second attempt at something that went wrong the first time. The description is cryptic, so the exact scene is per community guides. Provisional missable: it may only be possible in one story window, so do not skip the story scene that leads into it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play the story — the trigger is a specific scene
Do not skip the scene that leads into it
Complete the second attempt — the trophy pops

trophies.guide: Find the truth about the aliens. There is an alien and UFO side thread in Leonida — follow its clues (the related collectibles and encounters) to the end. The description is cryptic, so the exact trigger is per community guides; the collection menu shows the related items.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Follow the alien/UFO side thread
Collect the related clues
Reach the end of the thread — the trophy pops

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, lean out and strike enemies with a melee weapon — each kill counts. Do it during gang operations or police chases where enemies are close to the road. Ten kills total, and they add up across sessions.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon
Drive past enemies and strike from the vehicle
Each melee drive-by kill counts
The trophy pops at 10

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from heists — wash them through your contacts (the laundering menu shows the rate and the total). Run heists and robberies, then wash the Marked Bills until the total reaches $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn cash from heists and robberies
Launder Marked Bills through your contacts
Check the laundered total in the menu
The trophy pops at $250,000

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending counts — vehicles, weapons, properties, clothes, upgrades, across every shop. The spent total is shown in the stats menu. Buy the big items and the total climbs fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy vehicles, weapons, properties or upgrades
Check the spent total in the stats menu
The trophy pops at $100,000

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are bought from the property menu or the in-game real-estate site — each one costs money, so save up. The property menu shows which garages you own. Buy all eight and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Open the property menu
Buy a garage
Repeat for all 8 garages
The trophy pops on the eighth

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are registered. The app shows which vehicles are registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register a vehicle
Repeat for 10 vehicles — the trophy pops
